title: Opt-in provenance capture hook (fail-open) feeding the hk ledger
description: PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook that appends session-created artifacts (new files, branches, worktrees, containers, background commands) to a gitignored per-session ledger. Disabled unless enabled in .housekeeping.toml. Exits 0 on every failure path.

acceptanceCriteria.text: hook is registered in hooks/hooks.json and is a no-op unless [provenance] enabled = true
hook exits 0 on malformed input, missing config, and unwritable ledger, proven by tests
ledger entries are consumed by hk inventory as provenance=ledger

implementationNotes: Evidence: hooks/hooks.json (PreToolUse Write|Edit|NotebookEdit, PostToolUse Bash, timeout 5), hooks/capture.py no-op unless [provenance] enabled; tests: test_malformed_input_exits_zero_silently, test_noop_without_config, test_unwritable_ledger_still_exits_zero, test_records_new_file_branch_worktree_and_background; ledger->provenance: test_ledger_provenance_lowers_nothing_but_skips_the_raise.
finalSummary: Delivered in https://github.com/opum-ai/housekeeping-skills/pull/1 (feature branch feat/HS-1-housekeeping-skills-0.1.0). Verified before merge: pytest 29 passed on Python 3.9.6, lore check exit 0, claude plugin validate passed; eval iteration 2 (evals/benchmarks/iteration-2) with 98.6% vs without 88.9%. No CI checks configured on this repository yet (HS-14 adds them).
